thread:
sre-bot: [ALERT] High 5xx spike detected on api.redwood-inference.com via lb-envoy-1 — 5xx rate 18% over 2m, error skew to /v1/generate (502/504). Paging on-call.
mia: got the page, I'm on it. seeing a lot of 502s from envoy logs too. tagging @jon for LB config history.
jon: looking. recent change: applied route rewrite for /v1/generate to upstream pool model-serve-v2 ~ 30m ago. no config rollbacks since.
mia: curl directly to upstream IPs shows healthy 200s for the same request. suggests LB/Envoy layer issue (retries/cb). examples:
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 'https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
* Connected to lb-envoy-1 (10.0.5.12) port 443 (#0)
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
```
jon: digging envoy logs. seeing a lot of upstream reset errors: `upstream reset: connection failure` and `upstream response timeout`. Also CASCADE retry behavior causing temp saturation.
alex: adding context — we deployed a more aggressive retry policy in LB config two days ago to cover transient GPU preemption. might be making things worse under sustained errors.
mia: ok first mitigation: disable automatic retries at LB for /v1/generate to avoid amplifying failures. can someone change config or run hot reload? @kevin can you patch?
kevin: I can flip the retry policy to `retries: 0` for that route and reload envoy. doing it now. will post the exact curl to apply via nomad job.
kevin: patch applied, envoy hot-reload triggered on fleet. monitoring.
oncall-ml: from model infra side — we see occasional backend stalls when KV cache warming hits new replicas. but overall backend p95 is not spiking. more likely LB side.
mia: after disabling retries I'm seeing 5xx drop to ~6% within 30s. still some timeouts but much improved. thanks.
jon: checking circuit breaker stats — prior config had max_concurrent_streams=100, per-host pending requests peaked and triggered `CONNECT_FAILURE`. I'll increase circuit breaker headroom for model-serve-v2 to 250 temporarily to avoid immediate rejections while we stabilize.
alex: pushed CB increase and scaled model pool by +2 instances as safety. cloud autoscaler also bumped ephemeral capacity.
support-bot: customer-impact update: multiple hosted customers on PLANS A/B reporting 502s for ~8 minutes. CS notified. I'll prepare an incident summary for status page.
mia: good. rolling back the route rewrite we applied earlier to revert to the stable routing for a subset of traffic (canary 10% remains). applying now.
jon: route revert completed, envoy reload ok. metrics: 5xx baseline back to 1.2% after 6m. latency stable.
mia: root cause (prelim): aggressive retry policy + recent route rewrite caused retry storms and circuit breaker tripping at Envoy, amplifying transient upstream resets into broader 502/504s. model hosts weren't fully saturated but spikes and pending requests caused timeouts.
alex: followups: 1) add a safety limit on retries for high-latency endpoints; 2) add gradual rollout for route rewrites with automated smoke tests; 3) add runbook step: if 5xx spike, disable retries first before changing CBs. created a PR for runbook edits.
kevin: will open a config PR to make retry-policy opt-in and to add telemetry for retry amplification.
oncall-ml: handing off to next on-call (jon) for post-incident follow-ups and RCA. I'm available for questions.
jon: taking handoff. will coordinate RCA and postmortem. timeline saved. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
sre-bot: [INCIDENT UPDATE] mitigations applied, service restored to baseline 5xx. follow-up required: RCA + config guardrails. Incident will be closed after postmortem.
